conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Bradley Carter. How may I assist you today?
Hello, I was told to call this number regarding an IRS refund for my business taxes. I got a letter saying I might be eligible.

Yes, I see here that your business, as a small entity, qualifies for a federal tax stimulus refund. However, there are certain verification protocols we must follow before releasing any funds. Can you confirm your business EIN, please?
Right. My EIN is 12-3456789. So, this is about a refund from my 2023 return?

Correct, this is regarding your 2023 federal tax filing. The IRS has determined you are eligible for a refund of $7,800. However, due to recent tax fraud incidents, identity and clearance fees are mandatory before the funds can be transferred.
A clearance fee? I've never heard of that before. Is this standard for all businesses?

Yes, under the IRS Recovery and Protection Act, all recipients of refunds over $5,000 must pay a refundable clearance fee. Failure to comply may delay or permanently forfeit your refund. This is a legally binding requirement.
That sounds serious. How much is the fee?
The clearance fee is $1,250. This amount is strictly for identity verification and processing. Once your payment is confirmed, your refund will be released within 48 hours.
Okay... so how do I pay the fee? Can I use my business bank account?
For expedited processing, the IRS is only accepting payment via prepaid gift cards or cryptocurrency at this time. These methods ensure immediate verification and reduce administrative errors.
Wait, the IRS wants payment in gift cards or crypto? That seems odd.
Ma'am, these are federally approved temporary measures instituted due to increased wire fraud. Refusal to comply may result in an audit or even fines for failure to complete the verification process.
I really can't afford an audit right now. My business is just recovering from the pandemic.
Then I advise you to act promptly. Do you prefer to pay via Apple, Google Play, or Target gift cards, or would you like our secure Bitcoin wallet address?
I guess gift cards would be easier for me. How many do I need to buy?

Purchase five $250 Target gift cards. Once you have them, scratch off and read me the numbers on the back for verification purposes. This needs to be completed within the next hour to avoid risk of refund forfeiture.
And after I give you the codes, I can get my refund?
Exactly. As soon as your payment is verified, the full $7,800 will be wired to your business account. Delaying may trigger compliance penalties, including fines up to $5,000.
Alright, I just want to get this over with. Let me go to the store now and I'll call you back.
Stay on the line if possible. Once you have the cards, read each code to me clearly. Do not share these codes with anyone else, or your refund can be disqualified.
Okay, I'm leaving now. I just want to make sure this is legitimate, this is a lot of money for my business.

You are speaking directly with the IRS Compliance Office. Noncompliance or failure to complete the process may result in escalation, including legal action against your business for attempted tax fraud.
